title: Non-anchor position-period prediction v14
rationale: This lane predeclares a position-period rule before scoring any new observations. It does not use public anchor-derived additive fragments, candidate words, routed key-material results, held-out anchor controls, or prior public-fragment structure screens as discovery evidence, so it is not another public-anchor mining pass.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared residue classes from the registered period set before any candidate-word, key-material, route, or public-anchor-derived fragment scoring is performed.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared structural rule over absolute K4 positions only.
Registered period set selected before evaluating any new observation file.
No candidate words, key-material offsets, routed span scores, or previously scored fragment values.
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations recorded before scoring.
Observation files that declare source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale before evaluation.
Independent target rows that are not EAST, NORTHEAST, BERLIN, CLOCK, EASTNORTHEAST, or BERLINCLOCK public-anchor fragments.
controls: held-out observation scoring when enough independent rows exist
source and archive validation before promotion
